# Header-only upstreams. Do not execute upstream CMake or optional FFT backends.
set(_sq_signalsmith "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}")
foreach(_dep stretch linear)
    if(_dep STREQUAL "stretch")
        set(_hash 4dc468e46f208415ca66567cacfd8fb22b01d321fcdb4c2452278fee2426b09d)
        set(_dir signalsmith-stretch-88061fd4eda56a2353c5d65c74aa3f4ccf76f9da)
    else()
        set(_hash e6d6a914189894fd728111b2a3209445ecd065aa9a5c1958f41b64ac3cef8b32)
        set(_dir linear-0.6.6)
    endif()
    file(SHA256 "${_sq_signalsmith}/${_dep}.tar.gz" _actual)
    if(NOT _actual STREQUAL _hash)
        message(FATAL_ERROR "Signalsmith ${_dep} archive hash mismatch")
    endif()
    file(ARCHIVE_EXTRACT INPUT "${_sq_signalsmith}/${_dep}.tar.gz" DESTINATION "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/signalsmith-deps")
    set(SOUNDQ_SIGNALSMITH_${_dep} "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/signalsmith-deps/${_dir}")
endforeach()
add_library(soundq_signalsmith INTERFACE)
target_include_directories(soundq_signalsmith SYSTEM INTERFACE
    "${SOUNDQ_SIGNALSMITH_stretch}" "${SOUNDQ_SIGNALSMITH_linear}/include")
